definitions.frame: One fixed orthonormal observer frame; g=diag(-1,1,1,1). Every norm below is positive Euclidean/Frobenius/spectral, never Lorentzian.
definitions.pair: j=1,2; real d_j in R^3, real R, ||d_j||<=sinh R, u_j=(positive sqrt(1+||d_j||^2),d_j). R>=0 is derived from an existing pair rather than added. S_j has the COMMON_SPEC h coefficient embedding.
definitions.inverse: B_j=S_j+(u_j^T S_j u_j)g, per accepted CAS01-C01.
definitions.epsilonZ: ||u_2-u_1||2. If represented by absolute optical vertex map Z0_j(n)=g(u_j,K)=u_j^0+d_j.n for K=(-1,n), this is the positive Euclidean norm of its 4-vector coefficient difference. It is not a sky RMS, relative-redshift error, dipole-only error, or uncalibrated data covariance.
definitions.amplitude: L=min(||S_1||op,||S_2||op), with Euclidean induced spectral norm.
definitions.units: u,d,R,Z0 and epsilonZ dimensionless; S,B,epsilonH,L carry the same COMMON_SPEC rate units; M dimensionless.

accepted_input_statement: CAS01-C01: B=S+(u^T S u)g; no prior proof script/result admitted
